reason: 1,500 is less than I pay for my booking software and I will not feel it, and this is the first thing in a while that is aimed at footfall rather than at my paperwork. The league table across weeks is the part I want, because a Tuesday that fills itself is worth far more to me than the fee.
objection: That screen on my wall has cricket on it, and cricket is why half the room sits there drinking. If I replace it with a bracket on a slow night I may be trading paying customers for eight people playing pool, and nobody has shown me that the same faces actually come back for week two rather than that just being a line in the pitch.
